DiveSegment.description:
Metadata for a single glider dive segment (one descending limb or ascending limb of a yo-yo pattern).
Links continuous trajectory time-series to discrete profile casts.

associated_profile_id.description: Identifier of the synthesized ProfileCastContract derived from this segment.
associated_profile_id.title: Associated Profile Id

direction.description: Descending ('D' for dive) or Ascending ('A' for climb).

dive_id.description: Unique identifier for this dive segment (e.g. 'ru29_dive_012_down').
dive_id.title: Dive Id

end_time_utc.description: End timestamp of the dive limb.
end_time_utc.title: End Time Utc

max_depth_m.description: Maximum depth reached during this segment in meters.
max_depth_m.title: Max Depth M

sample_count.description: Number of sample points in this segment.
sample_count.title: Sample Count

start_time_utc.description: Start timestamp of the dive limb.
start_time_utc.title: Start Time Utc

description:
Authoritative scientific contract for an in-situ trajectory mission (e.g. RU29 glider transect).
Includes platform metadata, spatio-temporal mission bounds, waypoints, and discrete dive segmentation.

dive_segments.description: List of discrete dive / climb segments comprising the yo-yo mission.
dive_segments.title: Dive Segments

end_time_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of trajectory track.
end_time_utc.title: End Time Utc

mission_name.description: Name of the mission / scientific campaign.
mission_name.title: Mission Name

start_time_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of trajectory track.
start_time_utc.title: Start Time Utc

total_waypoints_count.description: Total count of trajectory sample points.
total_waypoints_count.title: Total Waypoints Count

trajectory_id.description: Canonical unique identifier for the trajectory (e.g. 'glider_ru29_mission_2025').
trajectory_id.title: Trajectory Id
